[[Cobleri Arronn]] is a [[Grawl]] [[boss]] that [[spawn]]s in south-central [[Sacnoth Valley]].

== Location ==
* [[Charr Homelands]]
** {{NPC location|Sacnoth Valley}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Battle Rage}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Counter Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Mighty Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Overbearing Smash}}
* {{skill icon|Staggering Blow}}

== Notes ==
* The fight is made difficult by the large number of both [[Grawl Champion]]s and [[Grawl Dark Priest]]s which surround him.  Approaching him from the south, four of the closest Grawl Champions can be pulled away from the group, but all the others attack cohesively along with the boss.
* Area-of-effect anti-melee hexes such as [[Meekness]] and [[Enfeebling Blood]] are very useful, along with wards such as [[Ward Against Melee]] and [[Ebon Battle Standard of Courage]].  As always, a [[minion master]] can greatly help redirect damage from the team.

== Items dropped ==
* [[Cobleri's Hammer]] ([[unique]])

== Trivia ==
* Named after [[Aaron Coberly]] ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive_2&oldid=447273#Edielh_Shockhunter source]).
